100491.title: Wheel lacing overview
guidance: Inspect 1 EA LL Hub (Product Number HU-6280) and 1 EA LL Road Rim (Product Number RM-R436) for visible damage before assembly.

Using an assumed wheel-building stand, connect 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283) between the hub and rim with 36 EA LL Nipple (Product Number NI-4127), following suitable product-specific lacing guidance.

100492.title: Tire, tube, and reflector fitting
guidance: Fit 1 EA Road Tire Tube (Product Number TT-R982) inside 1 EA LL Road Tire (Product Number TI-R092) on the rim, taking care not to pinch the tube.
Fit 2 EA Reflector (Product Number RF-9198) using compatible mounting guidance. Check that they are secure and that the wheel spins freely.
